plain_english_policy: Imposing contribution limits on political parties to state candidates

effects.rationale: Limiting contributions from political parties directly constrains market dynamics in electoral funding, as it reduces the autonomy of financial flows between parties and candidates.
While not explicitly about public provision of services, contribution limits can be seen as a form of state intervention in the private (party) sector’s role in governance.
Contribution limits may disproportionately affect smaller donors or parties with limited resources, though this is indirect and context-dependent.
